title: Field Based Sales Consultant - Main Contractor
description:

Family owned and values led, we care about our people, our customers and the work we do.

We're looking for a commercially minded and relationship focused Main Contractor Sales Consultant to join our UK Sales team. Covering London & the Home Counties, Surrey, Sussex, Hampshire, the South Coast and Kent, you'll become a trusted partner to commercial, procurement, design, project and site teams, helping them find the right solutions for their projects.

Territory postcode areas include: BN, CR, CT, DA, GU, KT, ME, PO, RH, SM, SO, TN, TW and UB.

This is an exciting role where you'll work closely with some of the UK's leading main contractors, building strong relationships, identifying project opportunities and influencing specifications to drive profitable growth.

So, what you'll be doing?
- Building and developing relationships within key main contractor accounts
- Identifying and converting project opportunities through proactive account management
- Engaging with decision-makers at all levels across commercial, procurement, project and site teams
- Presenting Altro's products, services and technical expertise to meet customer needs
- Managing a robust sales pipeline, forecasts and account plans through CRM
- Working collaboratively with specification, technical, customer service, marketing and operations teams
- Sharing market intelligence and helping shape business opportunities across your territory

As well as an exciting opportunity and a competitive salary, what do we have offer
- Car allowance
- Private medical cover via our supplier BUPA
- Starting holiday entitlement of 25 days, with the option to buy more
- Defined contribution pension scheme
- Life assurance from day one
- Occupational Sick Pay and onsite Occupational Health Service
- Confidential 24-hour life management and personal support service for you and your family
- Enhanced family-friendly benefits, including Maternity, Paternity, and Shared Parental Leave
- Free eye tests for all employees
- A paid day off each year for volunteering
- Free car parking at all our sites
- Long service awards
- Learning and Development support, regardless of your career stage
- Various social events, including the company Christmas party
- Retirement advice and support

So who are Altro? A leading European manufacturer and supplier of premium flooring and wall cladding systems for construction and transport. We have been going strong since 1919! Family owned and run, we share family values; we care about you, each other and what we do.

Head to our?Life_at_altro?and?Life_at_Autoglym?Instagram pages to find out more about , and

Everyone is welcome at Altro for who they are, no matter what their background is or how they identify. We appreciate that everyone is different and with that diverse uniqueness we can all thrive. We don t want you to just work here. We want you to belong here.

title: Internal Sales Executive
description:
Internal Sales Executive / Project Administrator

Salary: Up to 35,000 Engineering Technical Sales Project Support

We're recruiting for an Internal Sales Executive / Project Administrator to join a growing specialist engineering business.

This is a varied role combining technical sales, customer enquiries, quotations and project administration. You'll work closely with customers, contractors and engineers, supporting projects from initial enquiry through to delivery.

The Role
- Prepare quotations, proposals and pricing for customers.
- Review technical specifications, drawings and tender documents.
- Liaise with contractors, consultants, suppliers and engineers.
- Provide project administration support, coordinating documentation and technical information.
- Follow up quotations and help convert enquiries into orders.
- Monitor project progress, ensuring information is accurate and deadlines are met.
- Support the wider sales team with customer enquiries and ongoing projects.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an organised, commercially minded individual with strong communication skills and a proactive approach.
- Experience as an Internal Sales Executive, Project Administrator or within a similar sales support or coordination role.
- Background in engineering, HVAC, M&E, construction or building services would be advantageous.
- Experience preparing quotations, processing orders or coordinating projects.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident dealing with customers, suppliers and internal teams.
- Comfortable managing multiple enquiries and priorities.

Previous technical experience would be beneficial, although full product training will be provided.

The Opportunity

This Internal Sales Executive / Project Administrator position offers the chance to join an established, growing engineering business in a varied role with genuine responsibility and progression opportunities.

Salary up to 35,000, depending on experience.

Whether you're an experienced Internal Sales Executive looking for greater project involvement or a Project Administrator wanting to develop your commercial and technical skills, we'd be keen to hear from you.
